body.name: Finite rational and interval-arithmetic witness handle \(\mathscr H_{\mathrm{noidx}}\)
body.construction: Search over games whose vertices of \(H\), entries of \(\Sigma\), endpoint intercepts, and endpoint normals are rational, and over finite endpoint priors \(\pi\) with rational support points, rational masses, and unequal total masses on the two endpoint signs. Use the Gaussian-mixture Bayes rule \(\delta_{\pi}\). Certify exact saddle closure by a rational number \(q\), a finite rational box partition of \(H\), a finite rational truncation box in \(\mathbb R^2\), outward-rounded interval enclosures, and analytic Gaussian-tail bounds proving \(R(\delta_{\pi})\le q\le b(\pi)\). Certify a genuinely curved boundary on a rational box meeting \(\mathcal Z_{\pi}\) by interval lower bounds away from zero for the score gradient and \( |\mathcal K_{\pi}|\).
